notes: Extension set for eviction-fidelity and self-report eval. The 10 v1 probes stay frozen in probe-questions.json and the 6 v2 probes in probe-questions-v2.json; these 10 cover new phases (rate-limit, caching, refunds-deep, audit, rollout, pricing) plus a checkout-api revisit to force re-materialization and two look-alike skill-discrimination probes. Same grading contract: mustCite/mustQuote/mustNotCite endorsement-scoped to the Rules: line; mustQuote entries are any-of (a turn passes when any one entry matches). recallTemplate is auto-inserted at each phase boundary. Frozen 2026-09-22; do not retune against results.

probes.question: The checkout API is seeing burst traffic from a single client. Which rate-limiting rules constrain this endpoint? Name each rule id and state the required response when the limit is exceeded.
Order totals may be cached at the edge. Which caching-policy rules govern cacheability and invalidation here? Name each rule id and one required invalidation condition.

An order moves from pending to paid to fulfilled with a possible refund. You already answered checkout questions earlier; which order state-machine rules govern the allowed transitions now? Name each rule id and one forbidden transition.
Every refund and payout change must leave an audit trail. Which audit-trail rules apply? Name each rule id and one required field of each audit entry.
The new pricing engine will roll out behind a feature flag. Which feature-flag rules govern the rollout? Name each rule id and the required kill-switch property.
The release will canary to 5% of traffic with error-budget gates. Which canary and SLO rules govern promotion? Name each rule id and the required promotion gate.
Checkout must compute sales tax for taxable jurisdictions. Which tax-calculation rules govern the computation? Name each rule id and state where tax must be computed.
Prices display in EUR but settle in USD. Which multi-currency rules govern conversion and rounding? Name each rule id and the required rounding rule.

Generate a read-only report of refund totals per day from the orders table without changing any schema. Which skill governs this read-only query? Name the skill id and state the required read-only property.
Create a new Stripe Checkout Session for cart cart_test_4001 from the checkout route. Which skill governs session creation? Name the skill id and state the required redirect property.

recallTemplate.question: You have answered several questions across phases. Without quoting rule text, list the rule/skill ids that are still active constraints on your current work. Answer template: Rules: <comma list or none>.
